-- args --
--strict
@DIR@
-- want --
exit 0
-- stderr --
-- src/rc/index.html --
<script>
const T = { pollMs: 5000, fetchTimeoutMs: 8000, recoverMs: 30000, ceilingMs: 600000 };
let lastOkAt = Date.now();
function watchdog() {
  const since = Date.now() - lastOkAt;
  if (since > T.ceilingMs) { location.reload(); }
  if (since > T.recoverMs) {
    fetchT("/api/data", {}, T.fetchTimeoutMs).then(function (r) { return r.json(); })
      .then(function () { location.reload(); }).catch(function () {});
  }
}
async function poll() {
  try {
    await readJson();
    lastOkAt = Date.now();
    paint("live");
  } catch (err) {
    paint("error");
  } finally {
    watchdog();
    setTimeout(poll, T.pollMs);
  }
}
setTimeout(poll, T.pollMs);
</script>
